integrity: The stability region is proved by necessary-and-sufficient Jury conditions and the rate optimum by exact root differentiation. The bundled checker is a finite consistency replay, not the infinite proof. The standard alpha=1 identity-operator slice is treated as prior rather than as a novelty claim.
scientific_limitations: Exact deterministic scalar analysis for the fixed-step constant-reflection generalized FRB family with g identically zero and F(x)=a x. It is not a robust theorem for general strongly monotone, nonnormal, nonlinear, constrained, composite, adaptive, or stochastic problems.
title: Coercive scalar reversal of reflection tuning in generalized FRB
